rows.note: Use this as the everyday choice when someone is forced or driven away.

example.english: A major fire can displace everyone in a village.
example.traditional: 場大火可以逼走成條村啲人。
example.jyutping: coeng4 daai6 fo2 ho2 ji5 bik1 zau2 seng4 tiu4 cyun1 di1 jan4

rows.note: Use this for physically moving a person or object away, without necessarily stressing coercion.

example.english: We need to displace the table to make room.
example.traditional: 我哋要搬走張枱，騰個位出嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 bun1 zau2 zoeng1 toi4 tang4 go3 wai2 ceot1 lei4

rows.note: Use this when one thing replaces another because it is better, newer, or more suitable.

example.english: The new system will displace the old one.
example.jyutping: san1 hai6 tung2 wui5 ceoi2 doi6 gau6 go2 tou3
